_readme: Partner links that are not transfer services: flights home, travel eSIMs, and sponsors on the house calculator.

travel.flightsUrl: the flight search each 'Search flights' button opens. Placeholders: {from} and {to} (airport or city codes, e.g. LON, NBO), {fromCity} and {toCity} (names), {route} (e.g. fly-kenya).
travel.flightsWrap: once Travelpayouts (or another network) approves you, paste its tracked link here with the destination replaced by {url}. Leave empty for a plain, untracked link.
travel.esimUrl / travel.esimWrap: the same for the eSIM button. {country} is the country name.

sponsors: paid listings on the house-calculator pages. Each needs id (lowercase, no spaces), name, category, blurb, url (https), countries (ids from data/build-costs.json), starts and ends (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: phone, badge. A sponsor shows only between starts and ends, always labelled Sponsored, and never changes the receipt.
origins: departure cities per sending region. airports: arrival airports per receiving country. Codes are IATA city or airport codes.

travel.extras: more trip-home partners (Travelpayouts). Each: id (lowercase), name, kind (one of flights, transfer, car, esim, claim, activity), blurb, url (https), wrap (tracked link with {url}), optional countries (receiver ids; omit = all). Shown on the flying-home pages and sent through /go/<id>?r=fly-<country>.

travel.flightsUrl is an Aviasales search path: {from}{dep}{to}{ret}{adults}, dep/ret as DDMM. Without dates Aviasales cannot search, so flightTarget always fills them (default: leave in 3 weeks, back 2 weeks later).

travel.esimCountryUrls: Airalo country page per receiver (airalo.com/<country>-esim); falls back to esimUrl. travel.kiwiUrl/kiwiWrap: Kiwi.com dated search used by /go/flights?via=kiwi. extras[].countryUrls: country page per receiver, else url.

extras.name: Kiwi.com
extras.blurb: Second flight search. Good at cheap combinations of airlines.

extras.name: Kiwitaxi
extras.blurb: Pre-booked airport taxi at a fixed price, with a driver waiting with your name.

extras.name: GetTransfer
extras.blurb: Compare offers from local drivers for the airport run or a long trip upcountry.

extras.name: intui.travel
extras.blurb: Book an airport transfer or a car with a driver in advance, at a fixed price.

extras.name: Economybookings
extras.blurb: Compare car hire at the airport, with insurance options shown up front.

extras.name: QEEQ
extras.blurb: Second car hire search with free cancellation on many cars.

extras.name: Yesim
extras.blurb: Another travel eSIM, with pay-as-you-go data.

extras.name: Saily
extras.blurb: Another travel eSIM, set up in the app before you fly.

extras.name: AirHelp
extras.blurb: Flight delayed 3+ hours, cancelled or overbooked? Check if you can claim up to EUR 600 (UK and EU flights).

extras.name: Klook
extras.blurb: Day trips, parks and tours to enjoy with the family while you're home.

extras.name: Compensair
extras.blurb: Second option for flight-delay and cancellation claims, no win no fee.
